name: Druid of the Claw
summary: Oben Rageclaw’s spirit waits in the barrows beneath Teldrassil, unable to rest. The Gnarlpine furbolgs have bound his body with a dark enchantment, and you can break that bond by destroying his soulless shell.

sections.title: A Severed Spirit
sections.body: Oben Rageclaw was resting in the barrows beneath Teldrassil when the corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs laid a voodoo enchantment over his sleeping body. The magic tore his spirit from his mortal flesh and trapped it in the Emerald Dream. Now his spirit lingers nearby, unable to rest or reclaim his body.

sections.title: Mercy for the Flesh
sections.body: Oben Rageclaw’s physical shell is under the furbolgs’ control. Enter the nearby chamber and destroy the mindless, hostile husk. Then use the furbolg charm over his remains to shatter the magic binding his soul.

faq.q: Why do I have to kill Oben Rageclaw?
faq.answer: The Gnarlpine furbolgs enchanted Oben while he slept, turning his body into a soulless puppet. His flesh remains under their control, so destroying it is the only way to break the enchantment and free his spirit.

faq.q: What is the Voodoo Charm used for?
faq.answer: The charm breaks the enchantment controlling Oben. After you destroy his soulless body, use the charm over his remains to unravel the magic holding his spirit.

faq.q: Where does Oben go after this quest?
faq.answer: Once Oben Rageclaw’s body is destroyed and the enchantment dispelled, his spirit can leave the mortal world and journey into the Emerald Dream to rest.

faq.q: Why are the Gnarlpine using voodoo magic?
faq.answer: The Gnarlpine furbolgs have fallen into corruption and madness. They have turned from their ancestral harmony to use foul sorcery and dark magic to subjugate nearby creatures and sleeping druids.
Oben was a night elf Druid of the Claw who entered a sacred slumber in Teldrassil’s barrows to commune with the Emerald Dream. The Gnarlpine furbolgs disturbed his rest and enslaved his body.

faq.q: Is Oben's spirit still talking to me while his body is alive?
aliases: why is oben in two places
faq.answer: Yes. The enchantment tore Oben’s spirit from his flesh. His ghost appeared near the chamber entrance, unable to control or re-enter the enchanted, empty shell inside.

angles.text: As a Druid, you see the danger when corrupted furbolgs desecrate a sleeping Druid of the Claw, leaving the body behind while its spirit communes with the Emerald Dream.
As a night elf, you know Teldrassil was meant to be your refuge. The Gnarlpine furbolgs’ corruption now threatens even the sacred barrows.
